challenge_scope: NASA Space Apps Challenge — Leveraging NASA Earth Observations for Agricultural Resilience in Angola's Central Plateau (Huambo, Bié, Huíla)
independent_project_notice: Independent hackathon project. Not an official NASA service. Does not use, contain, or modify any NASA logos, flags, or mission identifiers.

nasa_open_data_and_resources.role: Primary daily gridded precipitation dataset (25 NetCDF annual files extracted for Huambo, Bié, Huíla) powering onset detection and false-start risk curves.
25-year daily root-zone soil wetness (GWETROOT) and air temperature (T2M) baseline for crop moisture suitability and Mann-Kendall trend analysis.

complementary_weather_sources.role: 16-day deterministic weather forecast (kept strictly separated from 25-year NASA climatology).
6-month probabilistic seasonal outlook for forward crop-season planning.

ai_usage_disclosure.summary: Generative AI is used optionally for natural-language advisory narrative synthesis and for assisted software/documentation drafting. All scientific calculations and verdicts remain 100% deterministic.
ai_usage_disclosure.code_and_data_acknowledgement: Code and data: Generative AI models (Google Gemini / OpenAI fallback via src/rag_service.py) optionally synthesize human-readable extension text in POST /api/v1/advisory from deterministic metrics (with a local deterministic template fallback when no LLM API key is configured). AI coding assistants also assisted in drafting documentation and test scaffolding reviewed by the team.
ai_usage_disclosure.deterministic_scientific_core: All agronomic thresholds, NASA baseline percentiles, Mann-Kendall trend tests, Wilson 90% confidence intervals, false-start risk curves, and ciclo_diario.py v0.3.0 (SHA-256 verified) verdicts are 100% deterministic.
